gloss: to concentrate; to focus; to strain

definitions.gloss: to concentrate; to focus; to strain (one's eyes, ears, attention)
definitions.explanation: to direct one's senses or attention intensely toward something

definitions.gloss: to elaborate; to put great effort into
definitions.explanation: to apply careful effort and ingenuity

examples.english: I strained my eyes to look.

examples.japanese: {耳|みみ}を{凝|こ}らして{聞|き}いた。
{暗闇|くらやみ}に{目|め}を{凝|こ}らした。
{趣向|しゅこう}を{凝|こ}らした{料理|りょうり}。
{工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした{デザイン|でざいん}。
{知恵|ちえ}を{凝|こ}らして{問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}した。
examples.english: I racked my brain to solve the problem.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {目|め}を{凝|こ}らす (to strain one's eyes)
- {耳|みみ}を{凝|こ}らす (to listen intently)
- {趣向|しゅこう}を{凝|こ}らす (to devise with ingenuity)
- {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らす (to apply creative effort)

RELATED:
- {凝|こ}る (intransitive: to be absorbed in; to stiffen)
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}する (to concentrate)
